_readme: Hand-set thumbnails, for the few items the automatic picker cannot get right.
Keyed by folder name (the scan id shown at the foot of each card).
page: 1-based page to show, counted over the item's pages in the order the builder
reads them (jpg run in filename order; PDFs least-cover-like first).
crop: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of that page, applied instead of the automatic crop.
note: shown in the zoom caption.
Prefer fixing the heuristic when a case generalises. Use this when it does not.

btv1b10886816j.note: title page; the facing verso is blank
btv1b10886816j.why: A double-page opening, blank verso on the left. The automatic crop cannot isolate it: the empty page is framed by a ruled border and a gutter shadow, so it carries as much edge energy at the margins as the title block does.

US-Wc_M452-A2-B68-op54.note: title page, cropped to the leaf
US-Wc_M452-A2-B68-op54.why: Photographed oblong on a cream mount against a dark table. The automatic crop kept the mount's proportions and came out portrait; the book itself is landscape.
